name: Morkanaut

bonuses.name: Big 'n' Stompy
bonuses.text: When the Gorkanaut Charges it can move through any Huge or smaller individuals, forcing them to make a DN 2 Agility Test or suffer 1d6 Mortal Wounds.

bonuses.name: Transport
bonuses.text: If you are using the rules for vehicles from Church of Steel, a Morkanaut has 1 Nob Pilot, 1 Nob Crew, and space for 6 Passengers.

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 3 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Wall of Dakka
bonuses.text: The Morkanaut can fire each of its ranged weapons once as a Multi-attack without suffering a DN penalty.

bonuses.name: 'Ere We Go!
bonuses.text: If this Threat is Engaged at the start of its Turn, it gains +2 damage to melee attacks.

weapons.name: Klaw of Gork (or possibly Mork): Crush
Klaw of Gork (or possibly Mork): Smash

abilities.name: Klaw of Gork (or possibly Mork)
abilities.text: Each time an attack is made with this weapon the Morkanaut can Crush once, or Smash 3 times without suffering a Multi-attack penalty to DN.choose one of the following actions: Crush or Smash (profiles above).
If the Morkanaut rolls a Complication on a ranged attack Test using either its Kustom Mega-Blasta or Kustom Mega-Zappa, it suffers 1d3 Mortal Wounds.

abilities.name: Explosive
abilities.text: When a Morkanaut dies, roll a d6. If you roll a Complication, the Morkanaut explodes. Morkanaut Explosion: 18 +6 ED / Blast (150)

note: Print errors, copied as printed: Big 'n' Stompy says "Gorkanaut" (copied from that block); Blast (150) on the explosion; Determination 1d6. Mega-Zappa ED prints "17+2d   3 ED" with a gap; read as 2d3. Resilience prints "18 (AR 4)"; Rokkit Launcha prints "(6)", stored as count 6.
